messages.subject: Fwd: [R-sig-Geo] Access WMS (and alike) services from R?
messages.subject_clean: Access WMS (and alike) services from R?
messages.body_plain:
Hola!

He preguntat el tema de descarregar capes dels geoserveis de i.e.
l'ICC. En GIS això es fa molt sovint
amb el protocol WMS, d'ací la meva pregunta a la llista.
Pel que he vist, jo sí que tinc en linux un gdal que pot llegir wms.
Per tant, entenc que simplement es tracta
d'escriure un xml que especifiqui quin mapa i quina zona, i conectar
al geoservei.
QGIS ho fa, per tant R també ho hauria de poder fer. Fins i tot crec
que es podria aprofitar el que hi hagi a qgis
per a entendre com s'ha de fer.
Algú s'anima?
Agus

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Roger Bivand <Roger....@nhh.no>
Date: Wed, Apr 23, 2014 at 2:09 PM
Subject: Re: [R-sig-Geo] Access WMS (and alike) services from R?
To: Agusti...@ictja.csic.es
Cc: r-sig-geo <r-si...@r-project.org>

On Wed, 23 Apr 2014, Agustin Lobo wrote:

> Hi!
>
> Is there any project attempting to access remote geoservices such as
> WMS in a similar way
> as it is done with google maps (i.e. through ggmap:get_map()) ?

I've no idea how ggmap does this, or whether it uses WMS. Your GDAL
may have been built with a WMS driver - see gdalDrivers() to check.
The CRAN Windows rgdal binary does not have this driver. For driver
details see:

http://www.gdal.org/frmt_wms.html

which has examples of the short xml files needed to configure access
to such services.

Roger
